Binned clusters across E_att¶

In [12]:
from functools import partial

FRAC = 0.1
SAVE = True

for density in [0.005, 0.01]:
    for mol_or_pct in [PCT_BIN_COLS, MOL_BIN_COLS]:

        FIXED = {"density": density}

        bin_tag = "Pct" if mol_or_pct == PCT_BIN_COLS else "Mol"
        y_label = "Material fraction" if bin_tag == "Pct" else "Molecule fraction"

        stack_plot = partial(
            plot_stacked_replicates_fraction,
            y_cols=mol_or_pct,
            x_col="E_att",
            group_col="traj_replicate",
            style=style,
            label_map=LABEL_MAP,
            aggregate=True,
            aggfunc="mean",
        )

        with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):
            fig, axes = plot_panels_by_group(
                df=bcdf,
                panel_cols=["density", "angle_k_ppp"],
                plot_fn=stack_plot,
                fixed=FIXED,
                final_fraction=FRAC,
                run_col="traj_replicate",
                sort_col="step",
                n_cols=3,
                figsize_per_panel=(5, 4.8),
                sharex=True,
                sharey=True,
                label_map=LABEL_MAP,
                suptitle=rf"{bin_tag} cluster bins vs {get_label('E_att')}",
            )

            for ax in axes:
                ax.set_ylabel(y_label)

            handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
            fig.legend(
                handles,
                labels,
                title=f"Cluster bin",
                loc="lower center",
                ncol=len(mol_or_pct),
                bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02),
            )

            fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.10, 1, 0.95])

            save_fig(
                fig,
                "cluster_frac_vs_eatt",
                save=SAVE,
                outdir=OUTDIR,
                params={**FIXED, "frac": FRAC, "bins": bin_tag},
            )

style = PlotStyle(

In [14]:
Y_COLS = MOL_BIN_COLS
SAVE = True

DENSITIES = sorted(bcdf["density"].dropna().unique())
ANGLES = sorted(bcdf["angle_k_ppp"].dropna().unique())

for density in DENSITIES:
    for angle_k_ppp in ANGLES:

        FIXED = {
            "density": density,
            "angle_k_ppp": angle_k_ppp,
        }

        with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):

            plot_time_df = df_filter(
                bcdf,
                fixed=FIXED,
            )

            if plot_time_df.empty:
                print(f"Skipping empty combo: {FIXED}")
                continue

            print("\nPlotting:", FIXED)
            print("bin columns:", Y_COLS)
            print(plot_time_df[Y_COLS].sum(axis=1).describe())
            print("E_att:", sorted(plot_time_df["E_att"].unique()))
            print("replicates:", plot_time_df["traj_replicate"].nunique())

            n_by_panel = (
                plot_time_df
                .groupby("E_att")["traj_replicate"]
                .nunique()
            )

            time_stack_fn = partial(
                plot_stacked_replicates_over_time,
                y_cols=Y_COLS,
                x_col="step",
                group_col="traj_replicate",
                style=style,
                label_map=LABEL_MAP,
            )

            fig, axes = plot_panels_by_group(
                df=plot_time_df,
                panel_cols=["E_att"],
                plot_fn=time_stack_fn,
                n_cols=4,
                figsize_per_panel=(4.5, 4.4),
                sharex=True,
                sharey=True,
                run_col="traj_replicate",
                label_map=LABEL_MAP,
            )

            eatt_values = sorted(plot_time_df["E_att"].dropna().unique())

            for ax, eatt in zip(axes, eatt_values):
                ax.set_title(rf"{get_label('E_att')} = {eatt:g}")

            # Remove top-row x labels if there are multiple rows
            for ax in axes[:4]:
                ax.set_xlabel("")

            for ax in axes:
                ax.set_ylabel("Molecule fraction")

            legend_handles = [
                Patch(
                    facecolor=color,
                    label=get_label(col, LABEL_MAP),
                )
                for col, color in zip(Y_COLS, style.stack_colors)
            ]

            replicate_text = (
                f"{int(n_by_panel.iloc[0])} replicates"
                if n_by_panel.nunique() == 1
                else "variable replicate number"
            )

            fig.suptitle(
                "Molecule cluster-size bin fractions over time"
                "\n"
                rf"{get_label('density')} = {density:g}, "
                rf"{get_label('angle_k_ppp')} = {angle_k_ppp:g}, "
                rf"{replicate_text}",
                fontsize=style.title_size,
                y=0.98,
            )

            fig.subplots_adjust(
                bottom=0.12,
                top=0.86,
                hspace=0.38,
                wspace=0.12,
            )

            fig.legend(
                handles=legend_handles,
                title="Cluster size bin",
                loc="lower center",
                bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.005),
                ncol=len(Y_COLS),
                frameon=True,
                fontsize=style.legend_size,
                title_fontsize=style.legend_title_size,
            )

            save_fig(
                fig,
                "cluster_mol_frac_over_time",
                save=SAVE,
                outdir=OUTDIR,
                params={
                    **FIXED,
                    "bins": "mol",
                },
            )

            plt.show()

In [16]:
FRAC = 0.1
SAVE = True

EDGE_Q90_COL = "edge_strength_q90_qualifying"
EDGE_COUNT_COL = "n_molecule_pairs_qualifying"

required_cols = [
    "density",
    "angle_k_ppp",
    "E_att",
    "traj_replicate",
    "step",
    EDGE_Q90_COL,
    EDGE_COUNT_COL,
]

missing = [c for c in required_cols if c not in gfdf.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in gfdf: {missing}")

densities = sorted(gfdf["density"].dropna().unique())
angles = sorted(gfdf["angle_k_ppp"].dropna().unique())

with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):

    for density in densities:
        for angle_k_ppp in angles:

            FIXED = {
                "density": density,
                "angle_k_ppp": angle_k_ppp,
            }

            d = df_filter(gfdf, fixed=FIXED)

            if d.empty:
                print(f"Skipping empty combo: {FIXED}")
                continue

            d_final = final_fraction_df(
                d,
                fraction=FRAC,
                run_col="traj_replicate",
                sort_col="step",
            )

            summary = (
                d_final
                .groupby(["traj_replicate", "E_att"], as_index=False)
                .agg(
                    q90_edge_strength=(EDGE_Q90_COL, "mean"),
                    mean_n_edges=(EDGE_COUNT_COL, "mean"),
                )
            )

            if summary.empty:
                print(f"Skipping empty summary: {FIXED}")
                continue

            n_by_eatt = summary.groupby("E_att")["traj_replicate"].nunique()

            replicate_text = (
                f"{int(n_by_eatt.iloc[0])} replicates"
                if n_by_eatt.nunique() == 1
                else "variable replicate number"
            )

            fig, axes = plt.subplots(
                1,
                2,
                figsize=(11, 4.6),
                sharex=True,
            )

            plot_box_summary(
                df=summary,
                ax=axes[0],
                x_col="E_att",
                y_col="q90_edge_strength",
                style=style,
                label_map=LABEL_MAP,
            )

            axes[0].set_title("90th percentile edge strength")
            axes[0].set_ylabel("Mean q90 edge strength")

            plot_box_summary(
                df=summary,
                ax=axes[1],
                x_col="E_att",
                y_col="mean_n_edges",
                style=style,
                label_map=LABEL_MAP,
            )

            axes[1].set_title("Molecule-pair edge count")
            axes[1].set_ylabel("Mean molecule edges per frame")

            fig.suptitle(
                "Molecule-contact summary"
                "\n"
                rf"{get_label('density')} = {density:g}, "
                rf"{get_label('angle_k_ppp')} = {angle_k_ppp:g} "
                rf"(final {FRAC:.0%} of steps, {replicate_text})",
                y=0.98,
                fontsize=style.title_size,
            )

            fig.subplots_adjust(
                top=0.82,
                bottom=0.14,
                wspace=0.28,
            )

            save_fig(
                fig,
                "molecule_contact_summary",
                save=SAVE,
                outdir=OUTDIR,
                params={
                    "density": density,
                    "angle_k_ppp": angle_k_ppp,
                    "frac": FRAC,
                },
            )

Mean edge strength¶

In [33]:
FRAC = 0.1
SAVE = True

EDGE_MEAN_COL = "edge_strength_mean_qualifying"
EDGE_COUNT_COL = "n_molecule_pairs_qualifying"

required_cols = [
    "run_id",
    "density",
    "angle_k_ppp",
    "E_att",
    "traj_replicate",
    "step",
    EDGE_MEAN_COL,
    EDGE_COUNT_COL,
]

missing = [c for c in required_cols if c not in gfdf.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in gfdf: {missing}")

densities = sorted(gfdf["density"].dropna().unique())
angles = sorted(gfdf["angle_k_ppp"].dropna().unique())

with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):

    for density in densities:
        for angle_k_ppp in angles:

            FIXED = {
                "density": density,
                "angle_k_ppp": angle_k_ppp,
            }

            d = df_filter(gfdf, fixed=FIXED)

            if d.empty:
                print(f"Skipping empty combo: {FIXED}")
                continue

            # Select the final 10% separately for every simulation run.
            d_final = final_fraction_df(
                d,
                fraction=FRAC,
                run_col="run_id",
                sort_col="step",
            )

            # Average framewise metrics over the final 10% of each run.
            summary = (
                d_final
                .groupby(
                    ["run_id", "traj_replicate", "E_att"],
                    as_index=False,
                )
                .agg(
                    mean_contacts_per_pair=(EDGE_MEAN_COL, "mean"),
                    mean_n_pairs=(EDGE_COUNT_COL, "mean"),
                )
            )

            if summary.empty:
                print(f"Skipping empty summary: {FIXED}")
                continue

            n_by_eatt = (
                summary
                .groupby("E_att")["traj_replicate"]
                .nunique()
            )

            replicate_text = (
                f"{int(n_by_eatt.iloc[0])} replicates"
                if n_by_eatt.nunique() == 1
                else "variable replicate number"
            )

            fig, axes = plt.subplots(
                1,
                2,
                figsize=(11, 4.6),
                sharex=True,
            )

            plot_box_summary(
                df=summary,
                ax=axes[0],
                x_col="E_att",
                y_col="mean_contacts_per_pair",
                style=style,
                label_map=LABEL_MAP,
            )

            axes[0].set_title(
                "Edge weight"
            )
            axes[0].set_ylabel(
                "Mean edge weight"
            )

            plot_box_summary(
                df=summary,
                ax=axes[1],
                x_col="E_att",
                y_col="mean_n_pairs",
                style=style,
                label_map=LABEL_MAP,
            )

            axes[1].set_title(
                "Total edge count"
            )
            axes[1].set_ylabel(
                "Mean edges per frame"
            )

            fig.suptitle(
                "Molecule-contact summary"
                "\n"
                rf"{get_label('density')} = {density:g}, "
                rf"{get_label('angle_k_ppp')} = {angle_k_ppp:g} "
                rf"(final {FRAC:.0%} of steps, {replicate_text})",
                y=0.98,

Inter vs intra¶

In [24]:
def make_bond_long_df(
    adf: pd.DataFrame,
    fixed: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Build long-format contact-count dataframe from per-replicate summary adf.

    Uses:
        inst_inter_frac_late_mean * inst_particle_contacts_late_mean
        inst_intra_frac_late_mean * inst_particle_contacts_late_mean
        inst_particle_contacts_late_mean as total
    """
    required_cols = [
        "E_att",
        "angle_k_ppp",
        "density",
        "folder_name",
        "traj_replicate",
        "inst_inter_frac_late_mean",
        "inst_intra_frac_late_mean",
        "inst_particle_contacts_late_mean",
    ]

    missing = [col for col in required_cols if col not in adf.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in adf: {missing}")

    d = df_filter(adf, fixed=fixed).copy()

    if d.empty:
        raise ValueError(f"No rows left after filtering with fixed={fixed}")

    d = d.assign(
        intermolecular=lambda x: (
            x["inst_inter_frac_late_mean"]
            * x["inst_particle_contacts_late_mean"]
        ),
        intramolecular=lambda x: (
            x["inst_intra_frac_late_mean"]
            * x["inst_particle_contacts_late_mean"]
        ),
        total=lambda x: x["inst_particle_contacts_late_mean"],
    )

    bond_long_df = d.melt(
        id_vars=[
            "E_att",
            "angle_k_ppp",
            "density",
            "folder_name",
            "traj_replicate",
        ],
        value_vars=[
            "intermolecular",
            "intramolecular",
            "total",
        ],
        var_name="bond_type",
        value_name="bonds",
    )

    return bond_long_df

bond_colors = {
    "intermolecular": "#c50031",
    "intramolecular": "#0082E6",
    "total": "#420099",
}

bond_order = ["intermolecular", "intramolecular", "total"]

required_cols = [
    "E_att",
    "angle_k_ppp",
    "density",
    "bond_type",
    "bonds",
    "traj_replicate",
]

missing = [col for col in required_cols if col not in bond_long_df.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in bond_long_df: {missing}")

density_value = 0.01

plot_df = df_filter(
    bond_long_df,
    fixed={
        "density": density_value,
    },
)

if plot_df.empty:
    raise ValueError(f"No data found for density={density_value}")

eatt_values = sorted(plot_df["E_att"].dropna().unique())
k_values = sorted(plot_df["angle_k_ppp"].dropna().unique())

n_reps = plot_df["traj_replicate"].nunique()
rep_word = "replicate" if n_reps == 1 else "replicates"

with plt.rc_context(style.mpl_rc()):

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1,
        len(k_values),
        figsize=(15, 4.6),
        sharex=True,
        sharey=True,
    )

    axes = np.atleast_1d(axes)

    for ax, k in zip(axes, k_values):

        d_panel = df_filter(
            plot_df,
            fixed={
                "angle_k_ppp": k,
            },
        )

        if d_panel.empty:
            ax.set_visible(False)
            continue

        for bond_type in bond_order:

            d_type = df_filter(
                d_panel,
                fixed={
                    "bond_type": bond_type,
                },
            )

            if d_type.empty:
                continue

            plot_replicate_band(
                df=d_type,
                ax=ax,
                x_col="E_att",
                y_col="bonds",
                run_col="traj_replicate",
                style=style,
                color=bond_colors[bond_type],
                label=bond_type,
                band_mode="std",
                categorical_x=True,
                show_points=False,
                marker="o",
                markersize=4.5,
            )

        ax.set_title(rf"{get_label('angle_k_ppp')} = {k:g}")
        ax.set_xlabel(get_label("E_att"))

        # Force all panels to use the same E_att ticks, even if one panel is missing a value.
        ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(eatt_values)))
        ax.set_xticklabels([f"{e:g}" for e in eatt_values])

        if style.show_grid:
            ax.grid(True, alpha=style.grid_alpha)

    axes[0].set_ylabel("mean number of contacts")

    fig.suptitle(
        "Inter- and intramolecular contacts across "
        rf"{get_label('E_att')}"
        "\n"
        rf"{get_label('density')} = {density_value:g} "
        rf"(final 10% of steps, {n_reps} {rep_word})",
        fontsize=style.title_size,
        y=0.97,
    )

    handles, labels = axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    unique = dict(zip(labels, handles))

    fig.legend(
        unique.values(),
        unique.keys(),
        loc="lower center",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.02),
        ncol=len(unique),
        frameon=True,
        fontsize=style.legend_size,
        title_fontsize=style.legend_title_size,
    )

    fig.subplots_adjust(
        bottom=0.22,
        top=0.82,
        wspace=0.12,
    )

    plt.show()

save_fig(
    fig,
    "bond_contacts_vs_eatt",
    save=SAVE,
    outdir=OUTDIR,
    params={
        "density": 0.01,
    },
)
